name: Xkard Essential Card
summary: An entry-level virtual card for privacy-conscious users with a $25,000 annual spending limit and no KYC requirements.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Xkard Essential Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$49 per month. Card issuance is US$588.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Xkard Essential Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
